explanations.P01: High-Value Loyalists: highest overall monetary value, very high purchase frequency, very recent activity and broad category engagement in the accepted Step 4 profile.
explanations.P02: High-Basket Promotion-Driven Shoppers: highest average order value and highest promotion dependency among the three accepted primary behavioral clusters.
explanations.P03: Low-Value Occasional Shoppers: lowest monetary value and purchase frequency, longest recency and narrowest category breadth among the three accepted primary behavioral clusters.
explanations.RFM: RFM is the governed lifecycle view. The display labels do not redefine lifecycle state logic.

subtitle: How customer states evolve across governed relative time periods.

matrix_semantics.count_cell: Observed customers in the selected adjacent period pair moving from the row state to the column state.
matrix_semantics.rate_cell: Count cell divided by the total population of the row's from-state in that adjacent pair.
matrix_semantics.zero_fill: Valid matrix state combinations absent from the observed C.14/C.15 pair facts are represented as zero.
matrix_semantics.zero_population_row: If a valid from-state has zero customers in the selected from-period, all row rates are 0 and row_rate_defined is false.

governance.interpretation: Model-membership strength only; subgroup does not represent causal response, activation eligibility, or an independently trained segment.

rule.core_definition: Within the same time grain, period and ML group, nearest_distance_sq <= the group-period median.
rule.edge_definition: Within the same time grain, period and ML group, nearest_distance_sq > the group-period median.

subgroups.label: P01 — Centroid Core
subgroups.meaning: P01 customers at or inside the same-snapshot median distance from the P01 centroid.

subgroups.label: P01 — Cluster Edge
subgroups.meaning: P01 customers outside the same-snapshot median distance from the P01 centroid.

subgroups.label: P02 — Centroid Core
subgroups.meaning: P02 customers at or inside the same-snapshot median distance from the P02 centroid.

subgroups.label: P02 — Cluster Edge
subgroups.meaning: P02 customers outside the same-snapshot median distance from the P02 centroid.

subgroups.label: P03 — Centroid Core
subgroups.meaning: P03 customers at or inside the same-snapshot median distance from the P03 centroid.

subgroups.label: P03 — Cluster Edge
subgroups.meaning: P03 customers outside the same-snapshot median distance from the P03 centroid.

Lapsed.meaning: Previously acquired customer has no purchase activity in the current same-grain period.

New.meaning: First observed purchase occurs during the current same-grain period.
New.rule: is_pre_acquisition == False AND period_is_active == True AND first_purchase_occurs_in_period == True

Reactivated.meaning: Customer returns after at least one inactive same-grain period.
Reactivated.rule: is_pre_acquisition == False AND period_is_active == True AND first_purchase_occurs_in_period == False AND prior_period_is_active == False AND prior_active_period_count > 0

Retained.meaning: Customer purchases in both the immediately prior and current same-grain periods.
Retained.rule: is_pre_acquisition == False AND period_is_active == True AND first_purchase_occurs_in_period == False AND prior_period_is_active == True

NOT_YET_ACQUIRED.meaning: Household exists in the master identity universe but has no observed purchase as of this snapshot.

threshold_policy.reason: Lifecycle group describes observed period-to-period customer behavior. Distributional value thresholds are reserved for subgroup construction in C.6.

transition_semantics.inactivity: Lapsed represents current-period inactivity after acquisition

New — Loyal-potential.rule: period_baskets > same-snapshot New median OR period_sales > same-snapshot New median

New — Shopper.rule: period_baskets <= same-snapshot New median AND period_sales <= same-snapshot New median

Reactivated — Loyal.rule: cumulative_baskets > same-snapshot Reactivated median OR cumulative_sales > same-snapshot Reactivated median

Reactivated — Shopper.rule: cumulative_baskets <= same-snapshot Reactivated median AND cumulative_sales <= same-snapshot Reactivated median

Retained — Loyal.rule: cumulative_baskets > same-snapshot Retained median OR cumulative_sales > same-snapshot Retained median

Retained — Shopper.rule: cumulative_baskets <= same-snapshot Retained median AND cumulative_sales <= same-snapshot Retained median

threshold_policy.meaning: The rule architecture is frozen, while each numerical median is calculated only from the same grain, same period and same lifecycle group being classified.
